mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event (event_name, event_image_url, event_start_date, event_end_date, event_target_account, event_target_category, event_discount_rate, event_description) VALUES (#{eventName}, #{eventImageUrl}, #{eventStartDate}, #{eventEndDate}, #{eventTargetAccount}, #{eventTargetCategory}, #{eventDiscountRate}, #{eventDescription})
mapper.select: SELECT event_pk AS eventPk, event_name AS eventName, event_start_date AS eventStartDate, event_end_date AS eventEndDate, event_target_account AS eventTargetAccount, event_target_category AS eventTargetCategory, event_discount_rate AS eventDiscountRate, event_description AS eventDescription FROM event ORDER BY event_start_date DESC
SELECT MAX(event_pk) AS eventPk FROM event

SELECT event_pk AS eventPk, event_name AS eventName, event_image_url AS eventImageUrl, event_start_date AS eventStartDate, event_end_date AS eventEndDate, event_description AS eventDescription, event_discount_rate AS eventDiscountRate FROM event WHERE event_start_date <= NOW() AND event_end_date >= NOW() ORDER BY event_start_date ASC
